item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade_guhrad.lore: Click a Building Shed: builder guhs and wireless materials. Little teeth, nyeg!
item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade_zout.lore: Click a Building Shed: nature shapes, the leveller and block text. Always straight, never crooked.
item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade_saus.lore: Click a Building Shed: paint machine, tunnel drill and publishing in the library.
item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade_gloei.lore: Click a Building Shed: shapes up to 64 big and... POOF!
item.guhs.bouwkeet_upgrade.naar: Makes a shed a %s (draws %s chonk power)
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.0: Shape wand and brushes, shapes up to 16, roofs, own blueprints up to 16, the library
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.1: Builder guhs, shapes up to 24, wireless materials from every chest on the chonk net
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.2: Nature shapes, the leveller, block text, blueprints up to 32
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.3: Paint machine, tunnel drill, publishing in the library
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.niveau.wat.4: Shapes and blueprints up to 64, and Poof!
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bediening.uitleg: Move, turn or mirror the ghost, and see what you're still missing.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.loslaten.uitleg: The ghost stays, but this shed doesn't build it any more. That way you can pick a new project.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.geen_project: No project yet. Pick a shape, a roof or a blueprint, and the shed puts down a ghost of it.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bank_gekoppeld: The Bank Guh is linked: the shed takes blocks from it too.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.upgrade.al: This shed is already a %s or better.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.upgrade.eerst: First the shed has to become a %s.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.binnenkort.vormen:
Soon you'll pick a shape here: sphere, dome, tower, arch, heart, guh silhouette and lots more. Hollow or filled, with your own blocks.

Until then: try ghost building with the test hut!
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.binnenkort.daken: Soon you'll pick a roof here: gable roof, hip roof, tent roof or the guh ear roof.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.binnenkort.blauwdrukke: Soon your own blueprints, the catalogue and the server library will be here.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.proefhuisje.uitleg: A little pink guh house in front of the shed's door, to try ghost building.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bank.geen: No Bank Guh linked (click the shed with a Bank Key).
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bank.ja: Bank Guh linked: the shed takes blocks from it.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bank.kwijt: The linked Bank Guh isn't anywhere any more.
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.draadloos.ja: Wireless materials: %s chests on the chonk net
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.draadloos.nee: Wireless materials: from the Guh Wheel Shed (with chonk power)
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.vk.ja: Draws %s chonk power: the shed is running!
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.vk.nee: Wants %s chonk power but gets none: it works as handiwork.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.uitleg: Pick up to %s of your own guhs as builder guhs. Working now: %s.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.vanaf: Builder guhs come with the Guh Wheel Shed (with chonk power). Then they put on a little helmet and build along!
gui.guhs.bouwguh.geen: None of your own guhs near the shed.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.kan_niet: That won't work: four builder guhs already, or that guh is too far away.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.praat.1: %s whistles a tune... %s blocks to go.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.praat.2: %s: wahoog, this is going to be pretty! %s to go.
gui.guhs.bouwguh.praat.3: %s nudges a block straight. %s to go.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.pof.onder: There it is, all at once.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.status.0: A ghost: move it into place and press Build!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.terug.uitleg: Undoes your last building action (the last 5). The blocks you used come back, and so does what stood there.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.weg.uitleg: Removes the ghost. What's already built stays.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.alsnog.vraag: You don't have all the blocks. Build anyway? What's missing stays a ghost until you have it.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.vriend.erbij: This player may touch the ghost too
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.vriend.eraf: This player may no longer touch it
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.te_ver: You're too far from the ghost.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.mist: Done, but %s blocks were missing: they stay a ghost. Press Build! again later.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.nee.te_veel: You already have ten ghosts open. Build or remove one first.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.spook.nee.beschermd: No building here: this is a protected building.
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.title: &dBuilding Help
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.sub: The Site Shed, the Shape Wand, brushes, blueprints and animals that build
This chapter can start right away: you make a Site Shed with wool, a crafting table, logs and kaasknabbels.

Everything you build first stands as a &dghost&r. The &dSite Shed&r builds it for you, with material from your pockets, your Bank Guh or your chests. With &echonk power&r it grows from Handiwork to Glow Shed.

After that: the Shape Wand, brushes, blueprints, and animals from the safari park that build for you. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it before. The headings show what logically comes next. Tick this off and get chonking!
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_keet.title: A Site Shed of your own
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_keet.desc: Make a &dSite Shed&r (yellow and pink wool, a crafting table, logs and kaasknabbels) and put it down: a little shed of 3 by 3 by 3 with a crane on the roof. Click it for the menu with tabs. This is where building starts!
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_vormstaf.de: Make a &dShape Wand&r (two sticks and an amethyst shard). Click a block with it and your shape stands there as a &dghost&r: see-through, not real yet. Hold left &eAlt&r for the round menu with all the shapes and roofs.
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_eerste_bouw: Put down a ghost (with the Shape Wand or in the Site Shed), slide it into place and press &eBuild!&r. The blocks come from your pockets, your Bank Guh or your chests. When it is done, there is a little party!
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_guhrad.desc: Make a &dGuh Wheel Cog&r and click your Site Shed with it. With &echonk power&r (10 VK) your own guhs help as &dbuilder guhs&r, and the shed takes material from every chest on its chonk net.
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_zout.title: Salt Shed
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_zout.desc: The &dSalt Crystal Spirit Level&r makes a Salt Shed (30 VK): nature shapes, block text and the &dLeveller&r.
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_saus.title: Sauce Shed
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_saus.desc: The &dSauce Crane Hook&r makes a Sauce Shed (80 VK): the &dPaint Machine&r, the &dTunnel Drill&r and publishing in the server's library.
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_gloei.title: Glow Shed... POOF!
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_gloei.desc: The &dGlow Work Lamp&r makes a Glow Shed (200 VK): shapes and blueprints up to 64 big. And is all the material there? Then it builds everything at once: &dPOOF!&r
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_kwast.title: Paint away
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_kwast.desc: Make a &dSwap Brush&r: sneak-click a block to pick it, and every click paints a little ball of blocks over, in the same shape. There is also a mix, a pattern and a weathering brush. Animal patterns open up with your Safari Dex.
Choose &ecapture&r in the Shape Wand menu and click two corners of something pretty (or sneak-click a building once). That makes it a &dblueprint&r of your own.
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_ontwerpbure: Make a &dDesign Desk&r. There you browse your own blueprints, the catalogue with 25 designs and the server's library.
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_blauwdruk.d: Print a blueprint at the Design Desk (a sheet of paper). Click a block with it and the design stands there as a ghost. It never runs out!
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_blokken.des: The creative tab &dGuhs: Building&r has more than 400 new building blocks. Make a few &dpink pastel bricks&r: eight bricks around a pink dye.
Click the &denclosure sign&r of a helper animal (a beaver, penguin or orangutan, for example) and open the &eBuilding job&r tab. Pick a job, find a spot and confirm: the family goes on a work outing and builds it for you.
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.bouwhulp_beverbaas.d: Let your beavers build &efive beaver dams&r. Behind every dam the water rises and a beaver pool appears. You get the title &6Beaver Boss&r.
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.beverbeek_biome.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension lies a rare brook forest of willows, alders and birches, with wild beaver dams. Find &dBeaver Brook&r!
ftb.guhs_bouwhulp.q.beverbeek_spaander.d: Very rarely there is a &dranger post&r in Beaver Brook. Spaander lives there, a beaver you can't take along, but can pet lovingly. Pet him!
